title: Vineyard registry typepack entry
description: One row in community-typepacks.json. Symmetric with the plugin entry. Typepacks carry no scopes (no code executes); 'categories' drives the facet filter.

identifier.description: Reverse-DNS PK; equals typepack.identifier. The namespace is the AUTHOR'S OWN reverse-DNS prefix, two labels or more: `run.vineyard.*` is first-party, a third party publishes under its own (`com.acme.*`, `io.github.someone.*`). Claiming a namespace you do not control is a review question, not a schema one.

ref.description: IMMUTABLE commit SHA (40-hex SHA-1 or 64-hex SHA-256) of the content repo, captured at PR time. Tags/branches are mutable and REJECTED - pin the exact reviewed commit. Human-readable release is in `version`.

path.description: Path to the typepack JSON within repo@ref (= distribution.path).

categories.description: DERIVED: distinct types[].category values; drives the category facet.

state.description: `deprecated`: still safe, still loads, no longer recommended. `withdrawn`: must not load — for a type pack that means every node typed by it renders untyped, so withdraw one only when its content is gone or wrong, never merely to retire it.

reason.description: Shown verbatim to an analyst who has this pack installed. Write it for them, not for the registry: what happened and what to do.

replacement.description: Where users should go instead. Must be a live pack of the same kind in this catalog.

status.description: Present only on a DELISTED entry. The row stays in the catalog on purpose — deleting it takes the pack off the browse page but tells an already-installed client nothing, which is the one audience that needs to hear. See SPEC.md §7.
